title: BI Analyst

nodes.title: Business Intelligence Foundations & Strategy
nodes.subtitle: BI lifecycle, executive KPIs, translating business questions into metrics, data literacy
learning_objectives: Define leading vs lagging KPIs for commercial business units
Conduct stakeholder discovery interviews to identify core decision bottlenecks
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between a leading indicator and a lagging indicator in business metrics?
key_misconceptions: Measuring vanity metrics (total page views) instead of actionable business value drivers

nodes.title: Dimensional Modeling: Fact & Dimension Tables
nodes.subtitle: Kimball methodology, star schema, snowflake schema, slowly changing dimensions (SCD)
learning_objectives: Design enterprise dimensional models separating business events (facts) from context (dimensions)
Implement Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1 vs Type 2) to preserve historical data
feynman_prompts: Why does a Star Schema dramatically outperform a normalized 3NF schema for BI reporting?
key_misconceptions: Joining transactional tables directly in BI dashboards without dimensional modeling

nodes.title: Advanced SQL for Business Intelligence
nodes.subtitle: Aggregations, window functions, conditional CASE WHEN expressions, CTEs, self-joins
learning_objectives: Write complex analytical SQL calculating customer retention and churn rates
Structure clean, modular queries using Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
feynman_prompts: How do window functions allow calculating percentage contribution to total without self-joins?
key_misconceptions: Hardcoding date filters in SQL queries instead of using dynamic parameter functions

nodes.title: Data Warehousing Fundamentals (Snowflake/BigQuery)
nodes.subtitle: Cloud data warehouses, columnar storage, compute/storage separation, partitioning, clustering
learning_objectives: Analyze how columnar storage optimizes analytical scan queries across terabytes of data
Configure table partitioning and clustering keys to minimize query scan costs
feynman_prompts: Why is columnar storage 100x more efficient for analytical aggregations than row-oriented storage?
key_misconceptions: Running SELECT * queries across billion-row partitioned tables without partition filters

nodes.title: Power BI: Architecture & Service Ecosystem
nodes.subtitle: Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, workspaces, deployment pipelines, app publishing
learning_objectives: Manage Power BI development lifecycles across Dev, Test, and Prod workspaces
Publish and distribute secure Power BI Apps to enterprise organizational units
feynman_prompts: Why should business users consume reports via Power BI Apps rather than editing workspaces directly?
key_misconceptions: Giving read/write workspace access to 500 business consumers, risking accidental deletions

nodes.title: Power Query (M Language) ETL & Transformation
nodes.subtitle: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL), data profiling, merging, unpivoting columns, M formulas
learning_objectives: Transform un-pivoted monthly spreadsheet data into normalized tabular formats
Optimize data load performance by leveraging query folding to push operations to the database
feynman_prompts: What is Query Folding in Power Query and why is it critical for data refresh performance?
key_misconceptions: Performing row-by-row transformations in Power Query that break query folding

nodes.title: DAX Foundations: Context Transition & Measures
nodes.subtitle: Row context, filter context, calculated columns vs explicit measures, SUMX, CALCULATE
learning_objectives: Author performant explicit DAX measures adhering to filter context rules
Modify filter contexts dynamically using CALCULATE() and FILTER()
feynman_prompts: Explain the fundamental difference between row context and filter context in DAX.
key_misconceptions: Creating dozens of calculated columns that consume gigabytes of model RAM instead of using measures

nodes.title: Advanced DAX: Time Intelligence & Cohorts
nodes.subtitle: DATEADD, DATESYTD, SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR, custom 4-4-5 fiscal calendars, cohort retention
learning_objectives: Build robust Year-to-Date (YTD) and Year-over-Year (YoY) variance measures
Support complex enterprise fiscal calendars that don't match standard Gregorian years
feynman_prompts: Why is a dedicated contiguous Date Dimension table mandatory for DAX time intelligence to work?
key_misconceptions: Relying on auto-generated Power BI date hierarchies that bloat model file size

nodes.title: Tableau Desktop: Architecture & Data Relationships
nodes.subtitle: Tableau Desktop, hyper extracts vs live connections, relationships (noodles) vs joins
learning_objectives: Model flexible data sources using Tableau's logical layer relationships
Optimize workbook performance by creating scheduled Hyper data extracts
feynman_prompts: What is the architectural difference between a live database connection and a Hyper extract in Tableau?
key_misconceptions: Using live database connections against slow transactional databases for high-traffic dashboards

nodes.title: Tableau Advanced Analytics & LOD Expressions
nodes.subtitle: Calculated fields, Table Calculations (Direction, Scope), FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE LODs
learning_objectives: Compute cohort benchmarks using FIXED Level of Detail (LOD) expressions
Configure complex multi-pass table calculations with customized addressing and partitioning
feynman_prompts: Explain how a FIXED LOD expression computes values independently of the visualization's dimensions.
key_misconceptions: Confusing Table Calculations (computed on client view data) with basic row-level calculations

nodes.title: Executive Dashboard UX & Information Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Visual hierarchy, cognitive load, Z-pattern layout, typography, actionable alert widgets
learning_objectives: Design intuitive C-suite executive dashboards that communicate status in under 5 seconds
Structure information architecture so users can drill down from macro KPI to micro transaction
feynman_prompts: Why should an executive dashboard present high-level summary KPIs at the top before details?
key_misconceptions: Using 10 different clashing colors across charts instead of consistent semantic color coding

nodes.title: BI Governance: Row-Level Security (RLS) & Compliance
nodes.subtitle: Static RLS, dynamic RLS with USERPRINCIPALNAME(), sensitivity labels, data lineage
learning_objectives: Enforce dynamic Row-Level Security (RLS) ensuring regional managers only see their own sales
Track end-to-end data lineage from source database to executive KPI cards
feynman_prompts: How does dynamic Row-Level Security restrict data visibility without creating duplicate reports?
key_misconceptions: Creating 50 separate copies of a report for 50 regions instead of implementing dynamic RLS

nodes.title: Data Refresh Automation & On-Premises Gateways
nodes.subtitle: Enterprise gateways, personal gateways, scheduled refresh, incremental refresh policies
learning_objectives: Configure high-availability On-Premises Data Gateways connecting cloud BI to internal databases
Set up incremental data refresh policies that process only new or modified partition data
feynman_prompts: Why is incremental refresh essential for multi-hundred-million-row datasets in Power BI?
key_misconceptions: Running full historical data refreshes every hour, causing gateway timeouts and database load

nodes.title: Financial & Operational Modeling for BI
nodes.subtitle: P&L statement modeling, variance analysis (Actual vs Budget vs Forecast), waterfall charts
learning_objectives: Model dynamic Profit & Loss (P&L) statements with custom subtotal and EBITDA rows
Visualize budget variance and margin leakage using waterfall charts
feynman_prompts: How do you model irregular financial statement line items that don't fit standard relational schemas?
key_misconceptions: Attempting to build P&L reports without establishing parent-child account hierarchies

nodes.title: Predictive Analytics & Forecasting in BI
nodes.subtitle: Time-series forecasting, trend lines, anomaly detection, clustering, what-if parameters
learning_objectives: Add automated statistical forecasting and confidence intervals to trend charts
Enable interactive sensitivity analysis using dynamic what-if parameters
feynman_prompts: How does automated anomaly detection flag unexpected drops in daily transaction volume?
key_misconceptions: Presenting linear regression forecasts as guarantees without explaining confidence bounds

nodes.title: Stakeholder Discovery & Requirement Scoping
nodes.subtitle: User interviews, requirements gathering, mockups, prototype validation, change management
learning_objectives: Lead effective requirement gathering sessions with non-technical business stakeholders
Translate ambiguous requests ('I need visibility into sales') into structured metric specs
feynman_prompts: Why is showing low-fidelity dashboard wireframes essential before writing SQL or building models?
key_misconceptions: Building a finished dashboard over 6 weeks without showing interim drafts to the requesting stakeholder

nodes.title: Self-Service BI Strategy & Center of Excellence
nodes.subtitle: Curated shared semantic models, certified datasets, training business analysts, COE guidelines
learning_objectives: Publish certified enterprise semantic models empowering business analysts to build self-service reports
Establish BI Center of Excellence (COE) guidelines preventing duplicate metric definitions
feynman_prompts: Why are certified centralized semantic models critical to maintain a 'single source of truth'?
key_misconceptions: Allowing 10 departments to write 10 conflicting definitions of 'monthly revenue' in siloed spreadsheets

nodes.title: Decision Support: From Data to Action
nodes.subtitle: Insight synthesis, root-cause analysis, executive presentation delivery, tracking ROI of BI
learning_objectives: Synthesize dashboard metrics into concise, high-impact weekly executive summaries
Measure and communicate the tangible business ROI and cost savings generated by BI initiatives
feynman_prompts: Why is pointing out an anomaly useless to a business leader without proposing a root cause and next step?
key_misconceptions: Delivering data dumps without answering the fundamental business question: 'What should we do now?'

description: Master BI Analyst with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
